Prop Firm Command Center

Evaluations, funded accounts, payouts, drawdown and true prop profitability.

Prop firm metrics are tracking tools based on your Tradeprint data and the rules currently saved for each account. Prop firm rules can change and some rules depend on data that Tradeprint may not have access to. Always verify eligibility and current rules directly with your prop firm. Do your own research.
